known_facts: At 10:04 UTC, the checkout error-rate alert fired with an increased failure rate from 0.4% to 9%.
Deployment dep-1842 for checkout-api completed at 10:01 UTC.
Database latency increased approximately around the same time as the deployment and error increase.
missing_information: The exact point in time when the database latency began increasing.
Details of the external payment provider's reported intermittent errors, including the scope and nature of those errors.
Information on whether there were any changes to the checkout-api that would impact the payment processing.

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The recent deployment (dep-1842) has introduced a bug or issue affecting checkout functionality and payment processing.
supporting_evidence: The increase in error rate from 0.4% to 9% occurred shortly after the deployment.
evidence_needed: Confirmation that there were no regression tests or manual checks post-deployment.
Logs and test results showing failures after deployment

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The database latency increase is causing a delay in checkout processing, leading to increased error rates.
supporting_evidence: Database latency increased at the same time as the errors.
evidence_needed: Evidence that confirms database latency directly affects payment processing
Performance metrics before and after deployment

uncertainty_statement: The current timeline and available data do not conclusively indicate any single cause. Rollback and further investigation are recommended based on the collected evidence.
